callouts.danger_read_instructions: Please carefully read all the installation instructions before use of the multi-touch digital image dissection table for the first time.
callouts.info_questions: If you have any questions, please refer to the instruction documentation of the multi-touch digital image dissection table. If further instruction or clarification is needed, please contact us.
callouts.notice_power_supply: Please ensure the power supply matches local voltage standards before connecting.
callouts.caution_wifi_name: WiFi name must be composed of English letters. Chinese names will not be displayed.
callouts.warning_update_process: The installation process will take some time. During this process, please do not perform any operations on the dissection table, and do not turn off the power to avoid system damage.
callouts.tip_password_location: The password location can be found on the product label on the device (DXXX-XXXX format).
callouts.notice_brush_lock: When the brush is operated, the software will be locked and the user will not be able to use other functions in the software.
callouts.tip_exit_fullscreen: Double click on the screen or press Esc to exit full screen mode.
callouts.info_surge_protection: Taking into consideration safety, the table also comes with surge protection. In case the power is cut off during movement from horizontal to vertical, the table stays at its own place and neither goes up nor down.
callouts.danger_beep_warning: When the warning sound "beep" is heard, please stay away from the multi-touch digital image dissection table. Wait until the process is complete before approaching.
callouts.warning_rotation_wait: Do not continuously perform the hardware rotation. Each time the operation to switch the upright/flat function must wait for at least 5 minutes before performing the hardware rotation again.
callouts.notice_safety_mechanism: Due to the safety mechanism, if the machine is operated continuously for more than 3 times in a short period of time (within 5 minutes), the dissection table will enter the "safety protection mechanism" and be locked for 18 minutes. During this period, the vertical or horizontal function cannot be executed. Please wait patiently. After the mechanism is unlocked, the machine can resume rotating to the vertical or horizontal function.
callouts.caution_lifting_shared: The lifting mechanism is a shared system. When there is more than one multi-touch digital image dissection table in the same space, operating the lifting mechanism may cause all tables to perform the lifting mechanism simultaneously.
callouts.notice_emergency_stop: After the emergency stop latch is pulled out, reinsert it after the emergency is removed. The upright/lying down function operation will then resume.
callouts.danger_no_carry: Do not carry the multi-touch digital imaging dissection table during the switch between upright and flat functions to avoid danger. For Safety Reason: Do not leave the table in inclined position.
callouts.warning_not_covered: System damage caused by not following these precautions, abnormal behavior, or human factors will not be covered under warranty.
callouts.caution_cleaning: Please do not use volatile materials, commercially available cleaners, or water to rinse and clean. This may cause damage to the screen glass, panel, or hardware circuit board. Please use the special wiping cloth for the screen to dry wipe. When not in use, please cover the table with the special dust jacket provided.
callouts.info_system_upgrade: Taiwan Main Orthopaedic Biotechnology Co., Ltd. will upgrade the system for better performance at our own discretion.
callouts.warning_environment: Product damage resulting from use outside these conditions is not covered under warranty.

content.intro_paragraph: This product includes instructions for the hardware computer equipment and software program system. Please read this manual carefully before using this product and follow the system start-up mode to enable and operate the multi-touch digital image dissection table properly to avoid personnel injury and other damages caused by improper usage.
content.orientation_intro: The display can be configured in two orientations:
content.orientation_horizontal: Horizontal: Standard table position for dissection work
content.orientation_vertical: Vertical: Upright position for presentations and lectures
content.control_panel_intro: The control panel provides access to all device functions through physical buttons and a console interface.
content.start_intro: Configure the hardware equipment and power cord to start operation of the multi-touch digital image dissection table.
content.step_connect_power: Connect the console of the Asclepius to the AC power cord. Plugs may vary based on your country.
content.step_turn_on: Turn on the Asclepius. At this time you will hear the sound of the host running.
content.step_wait_init: Wait for the system to initialize and display the main menu.
content.ethernet_intro: Ethernet Connection: Connect the Asclepius to the Ethernet interface (10/100/1000 Base-T) using a standard network cable.
content.fcc_intro: This device complies with part 15 of the FCC Rules. Operation is subject to the following two conditions:
content.fcc_condition_1: This device may not cause harmful interference.
content.fcc_condition_2: This device must accept any interference received, including interference that may cause undesired operation.
content.emergency_stop_intro: If you need to stop the vertical/horizontal function in an emergency, pull the emergency stop latch on the lower left door panel immediately.
